```bash
     --header "x-apikey: tr_key001" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/trello.com/url_list?limit=20&cursor=tr_cursor1"
```

* `--header` supplies your API key (`tr_key001`).  
* Replace `tr_cursor1` with whatever pagination token you received previously.  
* The response will contain up to 20 URLs tied to *trello.com*, along with metadata like first seen, last seen, etc., plus a new cursor value for further paging.

If you run into rate‑limits or other issues, consult the [VirusTotal documentation](https://developers.virustotal.com/reference). Let me know if you'd like help interpreting the JSON once you've fetched it!
